hypothesis: The already selected unaugmented EEGNet retains useful unseen-person performance and a material paired improvement over fixed B1 on the independent12 people.
source_split_rule: Original30 ranked by raw SHA256 digest of mi-confirmation-20261001:source; first3 validation, remaining27 fit. No final refit on validation people.
preprocessing: Unchanged Cho2017 independent7s processing: first sample origin, fixed8 CAR, causal512to250Hz FIR retaining0.04s delay,50Hz notch and1-45Hz,8-30Hz waveform; cue0.5-2.5s completed500sample window. B1 reuses same7band covariances and pre-cue ratios.
neural_config: Exact eegnet and compute objects from selected_architecture_protocol; seeds42,43,44, no augmentation or target adaptation; source-fit scaling and earliest best source-person validation BA checkpoint only.
baseline: B1_EA_CSP_ERD_LDA fitted on same27 people; alignment uses original first60 unlabeled trials per source/target person; no target labels used for fit. This baseline has target-prefix calibration; EEGNet does not.
scoring: For every method exclude each person's original first60 trials from primary scoring, retain all later complete trials including author flags; first60 are not used for EEGNet adaptation. No score/quality-based exclusion.
primary_metric: Mean12 person BA; EEGNet first averages all3 predetermined seed metrics within each person, not best seed or ensemble.
arm_eligibility_rule: Both confirmation_gate and fixed seed42 artifact_gate must pass. Only then export and measure an isolated ARM implementation; no production installation or actuator output in this experiment.
failure_rule: Preserve and report negative confirmation. Do not retrain, change preprocessing, choose another seed or search classifiers using these12 people. They are no longer blind after this experiment.
